name: Custom CA and mutual TLS support for Eventstream connectors
description: Eventstream messaging connectors now support custom certificate authorities and mutual TLS authentication. This lets enterprises connect to brokers that require certificate-based trust, meeting stricter security requirements for streaming data into Microsoft Fabric.With this capability, you can:- Provide a custom certificate authority for connector trust validation.- Authenticate with mutual TLS for secure two-way connections.- Stream from secured brokers without weakening security controls.
